meta.title: Vice City Awaits — A Grand Theft Auto VI Fan Experience
meta.description: An unofficial, cinematic fan experience for Grand Theft Auto VI — scroll-driven storytelling, an interactive 3D piece, verified release information, and the world of Leonida.
meta.disclaimer: Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.

intro.heading: Leonida is calling
intro.paragraph1: Rockstar North returns to the neon sprawl of Vice City, this time as part of the sun-scorched state of Leonida — the studio's biggest and most ambitious world yet.
intro.paragraph2: Two criminals, one impossible score. Lucia Caminos and Jason Duval are pulled into a conspiracy that stretches from the beaches of Vice City to the swamps beyond it.

world.heading: Leonida
world.sub: Vice City & the state around it
world.intro: A fictional take on Florida — sun, swamp, and sprawl. Vice City is the beating heart: a Miami-inspired coastline of neon, nightlife and heat, wrapped in the wider state of Leonida.
world.loc1Body: Beaches, high-rises and nightlife soaked in pink and violet light — the series' most iconic city, rebuilt from the ground up.
world.loc2Body: A chain of islands strung along open water south of the city — marinas, causeways and the kind of heat that doesn't break at night.
world.loc3Body: A working harbor town of docks, freight yards and salt air — Leonida's rougher edge, far from the postcard skyline.
world.loc4Body: Old money and orange groves — a quieter, wealthier corner of the state, all manicured lawns and long driveways.
world.loc5Body: Wetland and backroads on the way out of the city — airboats, gators, and a slower, wilder pace of life.
world.loc6Body: Highlands and forest above the coastline — the wildest stretch of Leonida, largely untouched by the city below.

characters.heading: Lucia & Jason

lucia.name: Lucia Caminos
lucia.bio: One of the series' first playable women leads. Sharp, guarded, and done being underestimated — Lucia is in it for a way out.

jason.name: Jason Duval
jason.bio: Lucia's partner in a job that goes wrong fast. Loyal, volatile, and in over his head the moment the score turns into a conspiracy.
